title: Hanasato Minori — Aiming To Be An Idol!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-A

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Uh...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Why are you closing your eyes?
You didn't sleep well last night?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
No, that's not it.
I'm trying to do a menial rehearsal.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: M-menial rehearsal...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (What's a menial rehearsal?)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Minori is aspiring to become an idol and often practices on the rooftop after school. I'm sure she does so at home too, so maybe that's what she meant by menial?)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Kohane?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Ah, sorry. Don't mind me. I was just wondering, what exactly do you do for a menial rehearsal?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Well... I've been watching a DVD of this particular idol recently. The singing and dancing is so cute!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So a menial rehearsal is where I think about what it would look like if I'm the one singing and dancing instead.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh... So you don't actually sing and dance while you're doing that?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: No. I would be annoying the neighbors if I did that, so I just try to imagine it in my head!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Imagine? Are you referring to mental rehearsal, actually? Instead of menial...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Eep! You're right!
That's it! Mental rehearsal!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehehe... I mixed those words up.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe, it happens.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: That's amazing, though, doing mental rehearsals even at school. You're really hard-working.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Not true! For anyone aspiring to be an idol, this is the very least we can do to get better!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Being able to do it like it's just an ordinary thing is what makes you so amazing to me, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Don't say that! It's not that big of a deal at all, really!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: In terms of commitment, I'd say...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Look! Shiho's hands are moving while she's listening to music, right? She must be tapping out the bass notes.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Ahh, I see!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And that's amazing, right?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What do you want?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe, sorry for interrupting. I was just wondering if you're also doing some form of mental rehearsal right now.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Hm... Well, I guess you could say that.
When listening to band songs, I try to think about how I would play it.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Or how the bassist I respect would play it.
I try to picture a few things in my mind.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Ah, I knew it!
I do that too!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You can learn so much from those who are good at singing and dancing. I tend to watch their videos again and again!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Then I try to imagine what I would look like dancing the same moves.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: When I'm actually dancing, I also think about what the expert dancers would do at this or that part!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I understand. This is something everyone aiming to get better has to go through.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hm? What is it?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Ah... Well, you're always so cool and composed.
I was just surprised to hear you to talk to us so cheerfully.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yes, I was surprised too!
That was probably the first time I've seen you smile!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hey... I do smile.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Right! Of course you do!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, lunch break is over.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Aww, that's a shame.
I was hoping we could chat a little longer.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Kohane, Shiho, let's have another chat again soon!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes, please.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Once in a while's fine, I guess.
